move_towards.title: Move Towards
move_towards.description: Moves the current transform towards the target with the given speed. Returns True when reached.

start.title: Start
start.description: Triggered once when the logic script is initialized (usually on Awake/Start).

update.title: Update
update.description: Triggered every frame. Use dt (delta time) for smooth frame-independent movement.

is_grounded.title: Is Grounded
is_grounded.description: Checks if the object's collider is touching the ground. Useful for jumping and animations.
